Deliverables • Calculation report (PDF) with all castellation parameters, stiffener design and verification. • Fabrication-ready drawings (DWG + PDF). • Brief summary of assumptions, design code used, and any recommendations.

title: Experienced Fashion Customer Support Specialist
description: We are a growing American fashion brand for women of 40 and over, scaling fast. We are hiring the person who will own our customer experience. Read this properly before you apply. This is not general VA work and it is not general customer service. THE REALITY OF THIS ROLE Our inbox is a difficult one. Delayed parcels, sizing complaints, refund demands, dispute threats, and customers who are already angry by the time they write. Every email has money on it, and the call you make on each one is final. Two numbers define the job. Chargebacks stay under 1 percent, and refunds stay within target against revenue. Above 1 percent, payment providers stop working with us, and then there is no store, no team and no role. That sits underneath every reply you write. Protecting margin while keeping the customer delighted is one job, not two, and doing that one customer at a time, in writing, is the skill we are hiring for. The cases repeat, and you should recognise every one of these: - Day 14, the tracking has barely moved, and she wants it cancelled - The quality is not what she hoped for and she wants to send it back - The size chart said one thing and the garment says another - She wants to cancel after the order has already shipped - Her second line mentions her bank If that reads like your last job, we should talk. If it reads like a list of problems, this is not the role. How we work: we accept as few returns as possible. Instead of taking the item back, you offer cash back in steps, so she keeps the piece and stays happy. Choosing the right step for the customer in front of you, and knowing when to move up one, is the core of this job. If you already know why that beats a return, you will be at home here. Every customer is treated like royalty here, the angry ones included. Our customers are women of 40 and over and they notice exactly how they are spoken to, so the tone has to be right every time. We have response time targets, and quality still comes first. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Own the inbox and write as the voice of the brand. Warm, personal, generous. - Decide every outcome yourself. Cash back offers, order changes, replacements, exchanges, and where it is genuinely unavoidable, a return or a refund. Plus some light coordination with our supplier. - Work with our AI drafting system. It drafts from our playbook, you judge it, correct it and send. - Work from our written playbook and tell us where it is wrong. We expect the person in this seat to improve it, not just follow it. - Report directly to the founder and grow into leading this function. WHAT WE REQUIRE - 2+ years of customer service for a fashion or apparel brand. Not negotiable. - Experience with US customers, and with long delivery times on goods that ship from an outside supplier. - Experience in a store where most of the inbox is problems. Delays, complaints, refund requests and disputes, not simple product questions. Support here is harder than standard customer service and every case has money attached to it. We need someone who has already worked under that kind of pressure. - Experience working with cash back and partial refunds instead of returns. If your previous store simply approved every return request, that is not the experience we need. - Refund and goodwill decisions you made yourself, with numbers you can name. - Daily use of Claude or ChatGPT for customer replies, specifically for polishing drafts. You should be used to taking a generated reply, cutting what is wrong with it and fixing the tone before it goes out. - Gmail and Shopify. Gorgias is a strong plus, it is where we are heading. Excellent English, written and spoken. - A quiet place to work and a stable connection. Every day, not only on the first call. We speak several times a week in the first weeks, so this becomes obvious immediately. If you know your internet or your working environment is not dependable, this is not the role for you. - Minimum 4 hours a day now, weekends included, and the availability to go to 8 hours a day within the next month as we scale, with overlap with US business hours. If you cannot commit to that, this is not the right time to apply. YOUR FIRST WEEK You will be in contact with the founder every day. We go through the hard cases together and corrections are direct. It becomes clear very quickly whether someone is at the level this role needs, and we would both rather know that in week one than in month three. If any part of this post makes you hesitate, keep looking. We would genuinely rather you did. WHAT WE OFFER 7 to 10 US dollars an hour to start, and a clear step up into leading customer service and hiring your own team. On top of that, bonuses are tied to how the company performs. Customer service is one of the biggest levers we have, so when the business grows, you grow with it. Deliver here and you move up fast. HOW TO APPLY 1. Open your proposal with one percentage. A customer paid $59.95 for a dress in our sale, delivery took the usual 14 days, it fits and arrived perfect, and she writes: "The fabric just isn't what I expected. How do I send it back for a refund?" Returns go to our maker overseas at her own expense. We would rather keep the sale. What percentage cash back do you offer her in your first reply? Put that percentage on the very first line, written like this: 0.0%. Then one line on why. This is not the first test of the process. It is simply how we see who read the post. 2. Add a 60 second video, camera on. Introduce yourself, and tell us about your experience in fashion customer service and with fashion dropshipping. Use AI if you like, we use it every day. Generic proposals and untouched AI output are filtered out before anyone reads them. OUR PROCESS Shortlist, a written test with real emails from our inbox, a video call, then a short paid trial. Inside a week. The test is short and it uses real cases. One part asks you to write. Another gives you a finished draft and asks you what is wrong with it. We screen hard, and we pay well for the person who clears it.

title: Social Media Launch Strategist for Veganwander – One-Off Project
description: # Social Media Launch Strategist for Veganwander – One-Off Project ## About Veganwander Veganwander is an international travel platform for vegan, vegetarian and conscious travellers. We help travellers discover and book accommodations that match their dietary preferences, values and desired travel experience. Veganwander is not limited to fully vegan hotels. We use a flexible system of labels and characteristics, such as: * 100% Vegan; * Vegan-Friendly; * Eco-Friendly; * Wellness; * Yoga; * Retreats. These are examples rather than a fixed or exhaustive list. Additional labels, characteristics and travel themes may be introduced as the platform develops. Our website is approaching its MVP launch. The Veganwander brand, visual identity, website design and general positioning have already been developed. ## What we are looking for We are looking for an experienced social media and brand strategist who can translate our existing brand foundation into a clear and practical social media direction for the Veganwander MVP launch. This is not a rebranding project. We do not need: * a new brand identity; * a new logo; * a completely new brand book; * a redesign of our website; * ongoing social media management. We already have a brand book, visual identity and website design. These should be used as the foundation. The purpose of this assignment is to determine how Veganwander should present, position and communicate itself specifically on social media. ## What Veganwander will provide At the start of the project, we will provide: * our existing brand book and visual identity; * access to the current website and designs; * background information about Veganwander; * our mission, positioning and business objectives; * target-audience information and existing survey findings; * information about our labels and accommodation categories; * initial content ideas and recurring format concepts; * examples created by our content creator, where available; * an AI-supported research pack containing initial competitor research, observations and strategic hypotheses. The AI-supported material is intended to reduce unnecessary desk research. It should be treated as supporting input and working hypotheses, not as confirmed conclusions or a finished strategy. ## What we expect from the strategist ### 1. Understand the existing brand Review our brand book, website, positioning, target audience and initial content ideas. The goal is to understand the existing Veganwander identity and determine how it should be translated into social media communication. The existing brand can be challenged where necessary, but this assignment should not become an unnecessary rebranding project. ### 2. Review relevant competitors Review a focused selection of approximately five to eight relevant competitors or comparable brands, such as: * vegan and vegetarian travel platforms; * sustainable travel platforms; * niche accommodation platforms; * travel inspiration brands; * purpose-driven hospitality or lifestyle brands. We want to understand: * how these brands position themselves; * which audiences they appear to target; * what messages and content formats they use; * which visible patterns appear relevant; * what feels generic, unclear or repetitive; * where opportunities exist for Veganwander; * how Veganwander can distinguish itself. Public social media activity does not reveal actual bookings or commercial results. The strategist should therefore distinguish between visible evidence, professional judgement and assumptions that still need to be tested. ### 3. Evaluate the AI-supported research Independently review and challenge the research and ideas we provide. We expect the strategist to: * validate the most important observations; * identify gaps, incorrect assumptions or missing perspectives; * add targeted research where necessary; * avoid automatically confirming our existing ideas; * distinguish facts from assumptions; * make clear choices based on relevant experience and professional judgement. The strategist may use their own AI tools where helpful. However, we are not looking for a generic or largely AI-generated report. The value of this assignment should come from independent thinking, relevant experience and recommendations tailored specifically to Veganwander. ### 4. Define the social media direction Recommend: * how Veganwander should position itself on social media; * which audiences should be prioritised during the MVP launch; * what our central social media message should be; * which supporting messages are important; * how we should address vegan and vegetarian travellers; * how our labels and travel themes should be communicated; * which tone of voice fits the brand; * which platforms should be prioritised; * which content formats are most suitable; * what Veganwander should and should not communicate; * what should make Veganwander recognisable on social media. ### 5. Evaluate our existing content ideas We already have initial concepts for recurring posts, Reels and other content formats. These concepts will be shared with the selected strategist. We want an independent assessment of: * which ideas should be retained; * which ideas should be improved; * which ideas should be removed; * whether important formats or subjects are missing; * whether the formats are distinctive, useful and repeatable; * whether they are realistic for a small team; * how they could support awareness, trust, website visits and bookings. Our existing ideas should be treated as starting points, not fixed requirements. ### 6. Create practical social media guidance Translate the recommendations into a concise Social Media MVP Launch Guide that our team and content creator can use independently. ## Required deliverable The final Social Media MVP Launch Guide should contain: * a concise competitor overview with relevant conclusions; * recommended social media positioning; * priority audience segments; * central brand message and supporting messages; * tone-of-voice guidance; * communication principles; * practical "do" and "don't" examples; * guidance for communicating labels and travel themes; * recommended priority platforms; * recommended content formats; * four to six content pillars or recurring formats; * approximately ten example content directions or post concepts; * example hooks and calls to action; * recommendations for the period before, during and directly after the MVP launch; * a realistic publishing approach for a small team; * a simple measurement framework; * a clear distinction between MVP priorities and ideas that can wait until later. The guide should be: * concise and practical; * approximately 8–12 pages; * specifically developed for Veganwander; * delivered in an editable format; * usable by our content creator without ongoing strategic support; * clear about which conclusions are based on evidence, professional judgement or assumptions to test. We prefer a clear and usable guide over a long theoretical marketing report. ## Working process The expected process is: 1. Veganwander shares the existing materials. 2. The strategist reviews the brand book, website, AI-supported research and initial content concepts. 3. We have one online kickoff call of approximately 60 minutes. 4. The strategist conducts the focused assessment and develops the recommendations. 5. The strategist delivers and presents the Social Media MVP Launch Guide. 6. Veganwander provides one round of consolidated feedback. 7. The strategist makes the agreed final adjustments. We are open to small practical changes to this process if they improve the final result. ## Possible follow-up work The current assignment is focused only on strategy and social media guidance. If the collaboration works well, we may later create a separate Upwork milestone for: * translating the guidance into Canva templates; * developing the visual direction for recurring formats; * designing initial posts or carousels; * developing initial Reels; * reviewing content created by our content creator; * supporting the first social media campaign. Please indicate whether you can also offer content design or creation as a possible follow-up. This is helpful but not required for the current assignment and will not influence the assessment of your strategic capabilities. ## Outside the current scope The current assignment does not include: * creating a new brand book; * redesigning the Veganwander brand; * creating a new logo or visual identity; * changing or rebuilding the website; * creating a complete day-by-day content calendar; * producing or publishing all social media content; * ongoing account management; * community management; * extensive paid advertising management; * long-term marketing support. ## Preferred experience We are particularly interested in someone with experience in: * social media and brand strategy; * travel, hospitality, lifestyle or e-commerce; * launching consumer-facing brands; * Instagram and short-form video; * competitor and content analysis; * translating existing brand guidelines into practical social media guidance; * working with small teams and realistic MVP budgets. Experience with vegan, vegetarian or purpose-driven brands is helpful but not required. ## What success looks like At the end of the assignment: * Veganwander has a clear and distinctive social media direction; * we know which audiences, messages, channels and formats to prioritise; * our content creator can independently create content that fits the brand; * we have a realistic direction for the MVP launch; * we know what to test, measure and improve during the first months; * the final result feels specifically developed for Veganwander rather than based on a generic template. ## Application questions Please answer the following questions in your proposal: 1. How would you approach this assignment? 2. How would you translate an existing brand book into practical social media guidance? 3. How would you combine our AI-supported research with your own independent judgement? 4. How would you validate or challenge AI-generated findings? 5. Can you share one or two relevant examples from travel, hospitality, lifestyle or e-commerce? 6. What would you focus on when preparing a social media launch for an MVP? 7. Can you also offer social media design or content creation as a possible later assignment? 8. What information would you need from Veganwander? 9. Can you complete the assignment within one to two weeks? 10. What fixed price would you propose for the scope described, and what would be included in that price? Please provide a concise and relevant proposal. We prefer a clear approach and relevant examples over a general application or large portfolio. ## Project details * Project type: one-off strategy project; * contract type: fixed price; * expected duration: one to two weeks; * meetings: one kickoff and one handover or presentation; * revisions: one consolidated feedback round; * final language: English; * collaboration: remote; * possible follow-up milestone for design or content creation.

title: Full-Stack Developer for Live Trivia Game – Firebase & Game Logic
description: We are looking for an experienced **Full-Stack Developer** to work on a fast-growing live trivia game. **This job is NOT about creating or writing trivia questions.** The work is focused on the **technical side of the game**, especially how questions are stored, selected, delivered, updated, and managed. Our game is already live with active users, so one of our biggest priorities is being able to **make updates to the game without negatively affecting users who are currently playing**. ### $150 Paid Trial The initial **$150 fixed-price project is a paid trial**. We want to see how you work, how well you understand the existing codebase, the quality of your solutions, and whether you can work independently without creating new issues. If the trial goes well, we are looking for someone who can work with us **long term**. The compensation will **increase over time** depending on your performance, responsibilities, and the continued growth of the game. For the right developer, this can become a very good long-term opportunity. ### What We Need Help With One of the most important parts of our game is the question system. We need someone who can review our current implementation and make sure it is reliable, scalable, and properly designed. This includes: * Making sure users do not receive duplicate questions when they should not * Preventing the same question from appearing twice within the same game/session * Properly tracking questions a user has already played * Creating a reliable question rotation system * Preventing unnecessary repetition for returning users * Making sure question selection remains random while following the correct rules * Handling different categories and question banks correctly * Making sure the system continues working correctly as the number of questions grows * Making sure the system continues working correctly as the number of active users grows * Preventing race conditions and other issues caused by multiple users playing at the same time * Improving database structure where necessary * Finding and fixing existing logic problems and edge cases ### Making Updates Without Affecting Active Users **This is one of the most important requirements for this role.** The game is live, and we want to be able to continuously improve it while people are playing. We need a developer who knows how to safely make updates such as: * Editing or correcting questions * Adding new questions * Disabling or removing questions * Updating categories * Changing game logic * Fixing bugs * Adding new features * Updating database structures * Deploying new versions of the game These updates should be handled in a way that **does not break, interrupt, reset, or negatively affect active users who are already inside a game**. For example, if a player starts a game using a certain version of a question, and we update that question while they are playing, their active game should continue working correctly. The new version should be used when appropriate without unexpectedly changing the experience for someone who is already in the middle of a session. We want someone who understands concepts such as: * Safe production deployments * Backward-compatible changes * Question/data versioning * Active session protection * Database migrations * Feature rollouts * Rollback strategies * Testing before production deployment * Avoiding breaking changes * Handling live database updates safely We want to be able to **continuously update and improve the game even when users are online and playing**. We do not want to have to wait until nobody is playing before every update. ### Reliability Is Extremely Important We do not want temporary fixes that solve one problem and create another problem later. We want the system to be designed properly. We care heavily about: * No unexpected duplicate questions * No broken active games * No incorrect question states * No database inconsistencies * No unnecessary Firebase reads/writes * No race-condition problems * No updates that negatively affect active players * Clean and maintainable code * Proper testing before changes are pushed live * Ability to roll back safely if something goes wrong * Scalability as the game continues growing ### Current Technology Our game currently uses technologies including: * Next.js * React * Firebase * Cloud Firestore * JavaScript / TypeScript Strong **Firebase and Firestore experience is very important** for this role. ### Experience We Are Looking For We strongly prefer developers who have previously worked on: * Trivia games * Quiz applications * Question-bank systems * Educational testing platforms * Games with large content databases * Session-based applications * Firebase / Firestore applications * Live production applications with active users * Applications that require updates without downtime Experience with a **similar trivia or quiz game is a major advantage**. If you have previously worked on a system where questions needed to be rotated, tracked per user, prevented from repeating, and safely updated while users were actively playing, please explain this in your application. ### AI Usage Please do not apply if you rely on AI to do the majority of your development work without fully understanding, reviewing, and testing the code yourself. Using AI as a development tool is completely fine. However, we want a developer who **actually understands what they are doing**. You must be able to: * Understand the existing architecture * Explain why you are making a change * Identify possible edge cases * Review your own code * Properly test your changes * Understand the consequences of changes before deploying them * Diagnose problems yourself when something goes wrong We do not want copied AI-generated solutions that have not been properly understood or tested. ### Long-Term Opportunity We are not looking for someone just to complete one $150 task and disappear. The game is growing quickly, and there will be more development work as we continue adding users, questions, categories, game modes, and features. We want to find a developer who understands the project and can potentially continue working with us for a long time. **The initial $150 is only the trial. Compensation can increase significantly over time for the right developer.** ### Please Answer These Questions When Applying 1. Have you previously worked on a trivia game, quiz application, or question-bank system? Please explain. 2. Have you worked with Firebase and Cloud Firestore in production? 3. How would you prevent a user from receiving questions they have already played? 4. How would you prevent duplicate questions inside the same game/session? 5. How would you handle a question being edited while a user is currently playing that question? 6. How would you deploy updates or change game logic without interrupting users who are currently playing? 7. How would you safely add, edit, disable, or remove questions while active games are running? 8. Have you implemented versioning, safe migrations, rollback systems, or zero-downtime deployments before? 9. Have you worked on applications with many simultaneous users? 10. Please provide examples of similar projects you have worked on. **Please only apply if you have relevant experience and are confident working on a live production game with active users.**

title: SaaS Account Manager – Customer Onboarding, Technical Support & QA
description: SaaS Account Manager – Customer Onboarding, Technical Support & QA We are looking for a highly capable SaaS Account Manager / Customer Success & Technical Support Specialist to join an early-stage software business as we begin onboarding and scaling customers. We have developed a comprehensive booking and business management platform designed particularly for businesses providing mobile and location-based services. The platform manages areas including: * Online bookings * Services and service configuration * Staff/providers * Availability and scheduling * Service areas and travel zones * Customer management * User roles and permissions * Payments and payment integrations * Business settings * Notifications * Integrations * Mobile service delivery workflows * Business knowledge and operational settings The platform is technically advanced and highly configurable. We therefore need someone who can become an expert in the system and act as the bridge between our customers, product team and developers. The Role This is not a traditional customer service position. You will become one of the key people responsible for helping businesses successfully implement and operate our platform. Initially, you will work closely with the founders and development team to learn the platform in detail. Over time, we want you to take ownership of the majority of customer onboarding, account management and Level 1/Level 2 support. Your goal is to make it possible for us to onboard and support significantly more customers without every question or issue needing to go directly to the founders or developers. 1. Customer Onboarding You will guide new businesses through the complete setup of their account. This may include: * Understanding how the customer's business operates * Creating/configuring their organisation * Setting up services * Setting up staff/providers * Configuring availability and scheduling * Configuring service areas and travel settings * Setting up users, roles and permissions * Assisting with payment and other integrations * Reviewing business-specific settings * Testing the setup before launch * Training business owners and managers * Helping customers successfully move into live operation You should be comfortable speaking with a non-technical business owner, understanding what they are trying to achieve and translating that into the correct system configuration. Customers may not always know which settings they require. Part of your job will be to ask the right questions and recommend the appropriate configuration. 2. Customer Account Management You will become a trusted point of contact for customers using the platform. Rather than simply answering questions, we want you to understand: * How their business operates * How they are using our platform * What they are trying to achieve * Where they are experiencing friction * Whether the platform is configured correctly * Whether additional features or improvements could help them As customers expand their businesses, you may also assist with additional locations, providers, services or new workflows. 3. Technical Support & Ticket Management You will manage incoming customer support requests through our support/ticketing system. Responsibilities will include: * Responding to customer questions * Troubleshooting issues * Reproducing reported problems * Determining whether an issue is user error, configuration-related or a genuine software bug * Resolving Level 1 and Level 2 issues where possible * Creating clear technical tickets for developers when escalation is required * Adding screenshots, screen recordings and reproduction steps * Prioritising issues appropriately * Following tickets through to resolution * Communicating progress back to customers * Confirming that fixes work before closing tickets We do not want developers spending significant time responding to basic customer questions. Your role will be to filter, investigate and clearly define issues before they reach development. 4. QA & Product Testing Particularly while our customer base is growing, there will be periods where support volume is lower. During these periods, you will assist with QA and platform testing. This may include: * Testing new releases * Testing customer workflows * Trying to break workflows before customers find problems * Reproducing reported bugs * Regression testing fixes * Testing different user roles and permissions * Testing booking and scheduling scenarios * Testing integrations * Confirming development tickets have been resolved correctly We want someone who naturally thinks: "What happens if the customer does this?" rather than simply testing the expected path. 5. Customer Feedback → Product Improvement We are still actively developing and improving the platform. Early customers will therefore play an important role in shaping the product. You will help capture feedback such as: * "I don't understand this setting." * "How do I do this?" * "Why can't I do this?" * "This workflow is confusing." * "It would be easier if the system did this." * "Our business operates differently." You will identify recurring themes and communicate them clearly to the product and development team. Not every customer request should become a feature. We need someone capable of distinguishing between: Support issue → Configuration issue → UX problem → Bug → Feature request → Product opportunity. 6. Documentation & Knowledge Base You will help us continuously improve our customer documentation and support knowledge base. When the same question appears repeatedly, we don't want to answer it manually forever. You will help create and maintain: * Setup guides * Onboarding checklists * FAQs * Help articles * Short training instructions * Video walkthrough requirements * Troubleshooting guides * Internal support procedures Over time, we intend to use this knowledge base with AI-assisted customer support to resolve simple questions automatically, while human support remains available for more complex issues. What We're Looking For Ideally, you have experience in one or more of the following: * SaaS Account Management * Customer Success * SaaS onboarding/implementation * Technical customer support * Help desk/ticket management * Software QA/testing * Booking or scheduling platforms * CRM/business management software You do not need to be a software developer. However, you must be technically confident and comfortable learning a reasonably complex software platform. You Will Be a Great Fit If You: * Learn software quickly * Are comfortable exploring a system independently * Are extremely organised * Can manage multiple customers and tickets * Communicate clearly with non-technical users * Can explain technical concepts in simple language * Are comfortable working directly with developers * Can reproduce and clearly document software bugs * Think logically when troubleshooting * Have strong attention to detail * Can conduct online onboarding/training sessions * Take ownership of problems rather than simply forwarding them * Understand the difference between a bug, support question and feature request * Enjoy working with an evolving product * Are interested in growing with an early-stage SaaS business Language Excellent written and spoken English is essential. title: Looking for a Hong Kong Lawyer to Help Me Recover My Company Shares From a Nominee
description: About me and my situation Hi, I am a Dutch entrepreneur running e-commerce businesses, and I am looking for a Hong Kong lawyer to help me recover full legal ownership of a Hong Kong company. In 2024 I set up a Hong Kong private limited company. Because I am not a Hong Kong resident, a nominee was arranged to act as the registered director and shareholder on my behalf. I have this properly documented. I hold a signed nominee agreement and a signed transfer of shares with her, and a further signed agreement between us dated 16 December 2025. I paid her a one-time nominee fee of EUR 1,000. She never contributed any capital and never paid a single cent toward the company. I paid for the incorporation and every company fee since, the company email and bank account have been mine from day one, and every business decision over more than two years was mine. I have all the documents and the full evidence pack organised and ready to share. Since around that time the nominee has disappeared and I have no direct contact with her. Her identity and name are now being used by a counterparty in an ongoing international arbitration I am involved in, through a connected intermediary. Because of this I need to secure my ownership and get the register cleaned up. What I am asking you to do My strong preference is to resolve this through the ownership evidence and the nominee agreement, not through a long court fight. As a first step I would like a written advice: how strong my ownership position is on the documents and payment trail, the best route to confirm me as the true owner and correct the register of members (I understand this may involve a resulting trust and rectification under the Companies Ordinance), and what protective steps are available so the shares cannot be dealt with in the meantime. Please also give a realistic view of timeline and cost. Please note the company is the claimant in an ongoing international arbitration with its own counsel; nothing will be filed in Hong Kong before the timing is aligned with him, and you would coordinate with him. Nothing gets filed without my explicit go-ahead. I will share all names and documents after an NDA and a conflict check. I am based in Asia (GMT+8), responsive and easy to work with, and would like your first written advice within about 7 to 10 days. A few questions when you apply Are you a Hong Kong qualified lawyer, and at which firm? Have you handled a nominee shareholder or beneficial ownership dispute, or a rectification of the register of members? Tell me briefly about one example. What would you charge as a fixed fee for the written advice, and your hourly rate for any work after that?
